title: console(kanban): KanbanConfig.summarizeField is never read — board columns show the card count but no per-column sum
body:
QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#21782 · records-forms.view-type-gallery · acceptance[1]

Clause A2 of `records-forms.view-type-gallery` fails in the ObjectStack 17.7 pre-release checklist run objectstack-ai/objectstack#21782 (framework subject `316be321e`, console pin `2e818d0b51ec`). An independent verifier (VF3, RUNNER rule 7; live, two fresh loads, plus code) confirmed it: P3. It predates the 17.6.0 console pin `31971ff1e`; no open duplicate was found. Owner: objectui. A spec liveness entry is also owed in objectstack: `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:1789` declares the key with no verdict (ADR-0049).

## Reproduction

1. Stock showcase. The fixture is `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/views/task.view.ts:262-275`, board `{groupByField:'status', summarizeField:'estimate_hours'}`.
2. Server truth: summing `estimate_hours` per status over `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_task` gives backlog 30 / todo 36 / in_progress 100 / in_review 54 / done 24.
3. Browser, as admin: `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task/view/showcase_task.board`.
4. Expected: those totals in the column headers.
5. Actual: "BACKLOG 2" … "DONE 2" (count only), and the board's data request selects no `estimate_hours`.

## Mechanism

- Zero reads of `summarizeField` under `packages/plugin-kanban/src` (column header around `KanbanImpl.tsx:1066-1100`, `ObjectKanban.tsx`).
- The only consumers are `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:2002` and `:2517`, which add the field to the projection.
- There is no reader at `31971ff1e` either. No duplicate.

## Done when

Each column header renders the sum of `summarizeField` over the column's rows (pinned), or the key is retired under ADR-0049.
